title: Releasing a round contract
statement: Given a round contract for a machine that starts at an anchor, has positive running time, and ends either at the anchor or in an escape set, the release machine has a contract starting in its initial release state. Its endpoint is the round endpoint with its state mapped into the machine-state summand, its exit set is the image of the union of the anchor state and the escape set under that state map, and its precondition, running time, and head-position bounds come from the round contract.
hypotheses_covered: A round contract for the machine, anchor state, escape set, data type, and input
The round contract's positive-time, endpoint, exit-membership, and intermediate-time conditions
